settings.eyebrow: AI business intelligence and consulting for eCommerce brands
settings.heading: A brain for your business.
settings.text: One memory for everything your team, your store, your code and your marketing platforms know.

settings.heading: The answer is already inside your business. It is spread across places that never meet.
settings.text:
A dip in conversion has a cause. Part of it is in a Slack thread, part in a release, part in an ad account, part in last week's call.

No one person holds all of it. Neither does an AI that was only shown one of them.

settings.heading: Connect everything, and the answer is in there somewhere.
settings.text:
Every email, thread, call, task, release and store metric, in one memory.

That solves the first problem and creates the second: reading all of it, in order, every time someone asks.

settings.heading: So the brain files by meaning, and goes straight to what matters.
settings.text:
Records settle beside what they are about, not where they were written.

A question lands on the few that answer it, across your team, your store, your code and your marketing platforms, and comes back as one answer with its sources.

settings.heading: Every release is walked through the way a shopper would.
settings.text:
After each release, your store is exercised on desktop and on a phone, the way a shopper moves through it.

A failure that is confirmed is rolled back.

settings.heading: It looks for the failures that look fine.
settings.text:
A collection that quietly stops showing one product. A filter that returns the wrong ones. A checkout that no longer offers shipping rates.

Each has a known right answer, checked daily to weekly, and checked again before anyone is told.

settings.heading: And it knows what never to touch.
settings.text:
These checks never pay for an order, never submit a real form and never sign in to your admin.

What was checked, what was caught and what became of it sit in one view.

settings.heading: When something breaks behind your store, it is found first.
settings.text: Errors in the systems your orders depend on are picked up from the systems themselves, not from a customer writing in.

settings.heading: Diagnosed, fixed, reviewed and merged.
settings.text:
The cause is traced and a fix is written. A second reviewer reads it before it ships.

People set the rules for what may merge on its own. The work no longer waits for a free afternoon.

settings.heading: Then verified, the same way a release is.
settings.text:
Every fix is checked on the live store after it lands.

Security moves at the same pace. When a critical vulnerability was announced in October, our own systems were patched the next day.

settings.heading: Know what is happening across your business, and have it handled.
settings.text: We set this up around your store, your team and your tools, then run it with you.

settings.panel_heading: See it on your own store.
settings.panel_text: Pick a time and we will walk through what a brain, a site manager and self-healing software would look like for your business.
